name: Hatred To Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that hatred toward Christ is deeply rooted in rejection of His rightful reign, as illustrated by the citizens who refused to have the nobleman rule over them (Luke 19:14). This animosity extends beyond Christ Himself to include hatred toward His Father and His people, and it arises primarily because of His faithful testimony against the world. Such hatred is without just cause and is exemplified by the chief priests and scribes. The New Testament sternly warns that those who persist in this rejection face severe judgment and punishment, emphasizing the fearful consequences of despising the Son of God and the Spirit of grace (Hebrews 10:29-31).
